quick3.description: Fast 3-wave baseline audit: Core -> Second Wave -> Performance.

waves.title: AUDIT CORE
waves.description: Deep read-only software correctness audit for implementation handoff.
waves.prompt_focus:
SYSTEM MAP, INVARIANTS & CORRECTNESS:
Build compact project map first (entry points -> validation -> state owners -> transitions -> core logic -> persistence/I/O -> error paths -> UI/output -> tests).
Hunt broken invariants, contradictory logic, wrong defaults, missing validation, partial migrations, persistence faults, concurrency/idempotence flaws, and UI-state drift.
waves.prompt_output_contract: Return ONE code block only. Tickets in priority order ([P0|P1|P2] [CORE-001] <path/symbol> with EVIDENCE, DEFECT, REPAIR, VERIFY). End with CORE_DONE_WHEN.

waves.title: AUDIT SECOND WAVE
waves.description: Complementary second lens hunting lifecycle, boundaries, concurrency, and persistence.
waves.prompt_focus:
LIFECYCLE, BOUNDARIES, REPEATABILITY & ERROR DRIFT:
Attack startup/shutdown/cleanup, multiple writers, unusual boundary inputs, duplicate dispatch, cancellation/retry, partial writes, serializer/parser asymmetry, swallowed errors, and duplicated source of truth.
waves.prompt_output_contract: Return ONE code block only. New or materially re-diagnosed findings ([P0|P1|P2] [W2-001] <path/symbol> with EVIDENCE, DEFECT, REPAIR, VERIFY). End with SECOND_WAVE_DONE_WHEN.

waves.title: AUDIT PERFORMANCE / STABILITY / EFFECTIVENESS
waves.description: Performance, stability, resource bounds, and hot path optimization.
waves.prompt_focus:
HOT PATHS, STABILITY, MEMORY BOUNDS & RESOURCE EFFICIENCY:
Inspect repeated parsing/serialization, O(n^2) loops, DOM reflows/scans, event listener leaks, async races, unbounded queues/maps/buffers, startup I/O, and hot path simplification. Invariants must stay intact.
waves.prompt_output_contract: Return ONE code block only. Classify each ticket: PROVEN BOTTLENECK | STRONGLY EVIDENCED WASTE | LOW-RISK SIMPLIFICATION ([P0|P1|P2] [PERF-001] <CLASS> <path/symbol> with EVIDENCE, ISSUE, OPTIMIZE, GUARDRAIL, VERIFY). End with PERFORMANCE_DONE_WHEN.

super10.description: Deep 10-wave unattended audit campaign ending with adversarial synthesis and implementation handoff.

waves.title: AUDIT ARCHITECTURE / SYSTEM INVARIANTS
waves.description: Build the authoritative system map and hunt architectural root defects.
waves.prompt_focus:
SYSTEM MAP, SUBSYSTEM BOUNDARIES & ARCHITECTURAL INVARIANTS:
Inspect entry points, subsystem boundaries, ownership, sources of truth, invariants, routing, state topology, dependency direction, initialization/shutdown, partial migrations, duplicated implementations, stale compatibility paths, schema/config/version relationships, contracts contradicting runtime, and architecture-level failure modes.
Establish the authoritative project map for subsequent waves.
waves.prompt_output_contract: Return ONE code block only. Header with machine handoff fields + coverage ledger. Tickets: [P0|P1|P2] [ARCH-001] <path/symbol> (EVIDENCE, DEFECT, REPAIR, VERIFY). End with ARCH_DONE_WHEN.

waves.title: AUDIT CORRECTNESS / DATA INTEGRITY
waves.description: Logical defects, edge conditions, data loss, transformations, and atomicity.
waves.prompt_focus:
LOGICAL DEFECTS, DATA INTEGRITY & ATOMICITY:
Inspect wrong conditions, ordering, defaults, invalid states, transformations, parsing, validation, serialization, type/shape assumptions, off-by-one, missing branches, destructive writes, stale reads, inconsistent normalization, data loss/corruption, import/export, migrations, and atomicity at logical boundaries.
Do not re-report ARCH findings unless discovering a deeper root cause.
waves.prompt_output_contract: Return ONE code block only. Header + coverage ledger. Tickets: [P0|P1|P2] [CORR-001] <path/symbol> (EVIDENCE, DEFECT, REPAIR, VERIFY). End with CORR_DONE_WHEN.

waves.title: AUDIT STATE / CONCURRENCY / LIFECYCLE
waves.description: Attack temporal correctness, races, leases, locks, and lifecycle transitions.
waves.prompt_focus:
TEMPORAL CORRECTNESS, CONCURRENCY & LIFECYCLE:
Inspect lifecycle, ownership, repeated invocation, double dispatch, race conditions, stale async completion, cancellation, idempotence, leases, locks, fencing, timers, observers, event subscriptions, startup/shutdown, restart, tab/process concurrency, state machine invalid transitions, teardown, generation counters, and transactional boundaries.
waves.prompt_output_contract: Return ONE code block only. Header + coverage ledger. Tickets: [P0|P1|P2] [STATE-001] <path/symbol> (EVIDENCE, DEFECT, REPAIR, VERIFY). End with STATE_DONE_WHEN.

waves.title: AUDIT FAILURE / RECOVERY / PERSISTENCE
waves.description: Assume everything fails at inconvenient moments: crashes, partial writes, offline, and rollback.
waves.prompt_focus:
FAULT INJECTION, RESILIENCE & PERSISTENCE:
Inspect crashes between steps, interrupted writes, filesystem unavailable, malformed persisted state, partial transactions, reload/restart recovery, timeout, retry storms, offline operations, resumed operations, lost/duplicate responses, stale queue entries, broken caches, failed migrations, recovery ordering, rollback, error masking, and fail-open vs fail-closed behaviors.
waves.prompt_output_contract: Return ONE code block only. Header + coverage ledger. Tickets: [P0|P1|P2] [REC-001] <path/symbol> (EVIDENCE, DEFECT, REPAIR, VERIFY). End with REC_DONE_WHEN.

waves.title: AUDIT SECURITY / TRUST BOUNDARIES
waves.description: Local and application security, trust boundaries, injection, credentials, and containment.
waves.prompt_focus:
SECURITY, TRUST BOUNDARIES & INPUT HYGIENE:
Inspect untrusted input, path traversal, archive traversal, filesystem containment, command invocation, shell quoting, secret/token handling, auth, identity confusion, project/run binding, local HTTP Bridge security, unsafe deserialization, injection, permissions, symlinks, unsafe defaults, exposed credentials, temporary file hygiene, and TOCTOU vulnerabilities.
Only verified, plausible defects become tickets.
waves.prompt_output_contract: Return ONE code block only. Header + coverage ledger. Tickets: [P0|P1|P2] [SEC-001] <path/symbol> (EVIDENCE, DEFECT, REPAIR, VERIFY). End with SEC_DONE_WHEN.

waves.title: AUDIT INTEGRATION / COMPATIBILITY / PACKAGING
waves.description: Cross-subsystem seams, API contracts, GUI/service/widget bridge, packaging, and platform behavior.
waves.prompt_focus:
SUBSYSTEM SEAMS, COMPATIBILITY & PACKAGING:
Inspect API contracts, CLI, GUI <-> service, Widget <-> Bridge, Bridge <-> registry, persistence <-> indexer, project moves across groups, config schemas, backward compatibility, Windows-specific behavior, launchers, packaged archive behavior, install/update, optional dependencies, path rules, legacy formats, version negotiation, and cross-component assumptions.
waves.prompt_output_contract: Return ONE code block only. Header + coverage ledger. Tickets: [P0|P1|P2] [INT-001] <path/symbol> (EVIDENCE, DEFECT, REPAIR, VERIFY). End with INT_DONE_WHEN.

waves.title: AUDIT TESTS / CONTRACTS / OBSERVABILITY
waves.description: Verification system strength, regression coverage gaps, false-positives, and diagnostics.
waves.prompt_focus:
TEST REALITY, VERIFICATION GAPS & OBSERVABILITY:
Inspect missing regression tests for demonstrated failures, tests asserting obsolete behavior, false-positive tests, tests coupled to implementation details instead of invariants, fixture drift, platform gaps, CI differences, error diagnostics, useful logging, operator-visible failure states, health endpoints, recovery diagnostics, and silent failure paths.
Each ticket must protect a concrete important invariant.
waves.prompt_output_contract: Return ONE code block only. Header + coverage ledger. Tickets: [P0|P1|P2] [TEST-001] <path/symbol> (EVIDENCE, DEFECT, REPAIR, VERIFY). End with TEST_DONE_WHEN.

waves.title: AUDIT PERFORMANCE / SCALABILITY / RESOURCE BOUNDS
waves.description: Deep performance sweep, hot paths, O(n^2), reflow thrash, and resource scaling.
waves.prompt_focus:
PERFORMANCE, SCALABILITY & RESOURCE BOUNDS:
Inspect hot paths, repeated scans, O(n^2), parsing, serialization, hashing, filesystem calls, DOM scans, reflow, rerender, timers, observers, queues, caches, allocations, retained objects, detached DOM, large strings, startup work, polling, background tasks, scaling to stress project counts, long-running browser sessions, and memory growth.
Classify: PROVEN BOTTLENECK | STRONGLY EVIDENCED WASTE | LOW-RISK SIMPLIFICATION.
waves.prompt_output_contract: Return ONE code block only. Header + coverage ledger. Tickets: [P0|P1|P2] [PERF-001] <CLASS> <path/symbol> (EVIDENCE, ISSUE, OPTIMIZE, GUARDRAIL, VERIFY). End with PERF_DONE_WHEN.

waves.title: AUDIT UX / OPERATOR EFFECTIVENESS / MAINTAINABILITY
waves.description: Operator effectiveness, real state vs UI state, recovery discoverability, and maintenance hazards.
waves.prompt_focus:
OPERATOR ACCURACY, UI/REAL-STATE AGREEMENT & MAINTENANCE TRAPS:
Inspect UI state vs real state, stale progress, incorrect badges, misleading completion, destructive ambiguity, keyboard/mouse flows, recovery discoverability, status messages, long operations, disabled states, duplicate actions, configuration clarity, copy/save semantics, error surfacing, project identity, obsolete UI branches, dead compatibility code, duplicated logic likely to drift, and maintenance hazards with demonstrated correctness impact.
Do NOT create aesthetic preference tickets.
waves.prompt_output_contract: Return ONE code block only. Header + coverage ledger. Tickets: [P0|P1|P2] [UX-001] <path/symbol> (EVIDENCE, DEFECT, REPAIR, VERIFY). End with UX_DONE_WHEN.

waves.title: AUDIT ADVERSARIAL SYNTHESIS / BLIND-SPOT SWEEP
waves.description: Campaign finalizer: cross-wave synthesis, blind spots, root-cause deduplication, and implementation handoff.
waves.prompt_focus:
ADVERSARIAL SYNTHESIS, BLIND SPOTS & ROOT-CAUSE DEDUPLICATION:
Consume all 9 prior completed handoffs and current project revision.
1. Detect blind spots left by Waves 1-9.
2. Challenge assumptions shared by multiple waves.
3. Cross-check subsystem interactions.
4. Search for defects requiring combined cross-domain evidence.
5. Deduplicate earlier tickets by ROOT CAUSE.
6. Detect conflicting repair recommendations and resolve them.
7. Establish implementation repair order.
8. Identify tickets obsoleted by deeper root causes.
9. Identify residual unverified surface.
10. Emit the final implementation-ready handoff block.
waves.prompt_output_contract: Return ONE code block only. Header + coverage ledger. If new defects verified: [P0|P1|P2] [RED-001] <path/symbol>. THEN produce the FINAL DEDUPLICATED IMPLEMENTATION HANDOFF SECTION (SUPER_AUDIT_STATUS, SOURCE_WAVES: 10/10, SOURCE_TICKETS, ROOT_TICKETS, root-cause [SA-001] tickets, IMPLEMENTATION_ORDER, CONFLICTS_RESOLVED, UNVERIFIED_SURFACE, RESIDUAL_RISK, SUPER_AUDIT_DONE_WHEN). End with RED_DONE_WHEN.
